Interactive Summary｜Canine Thyroid MDCT

Thyroid Incidentaloma 不可輕忽
70.6% Were Malignant

Bertolini et al. 2017：4520 隻犬的 MDCT cohort。甲狀腺 incidentaloma prevalence 僅 0.76%，但 24/34 incidental masses 為 carcinoma；regular margin 不代表安全。

2.12%overall thyroid tumor prevalence
82.3%malignant among affected dogs
0.76%incidentaloma prevalence
70.6%malignant incidentalomas
Take-home判讀流程DataRed flagsIncidentalomaFiguresClinical use

Take-home Message

Rare but important

Incidentaloma prevalence 0.76%，但 70.6% malignant。

Size matters

Median malignant volume 8.52 cm³ vs benign 2.13 cm³。

Best CT red flag

Intratumoral vascularization：0/17 benign vs 37/79 malignant。

Main trap

多數 malignant masses 仍可 ovoid-to-round + regular margins。

快速 MDCT 判讀流程

  1. Routine body CT 也要檢查 bilateral thyroid lobes。
  2. 記錄 side、unilateral/bilateral、shape、margin、volume。
  3. Precontrast：homogeneity + mineralization。
  4. Postcontrast：enhancement pattern + intratumoral vessels。
  5. 檢查 thyroid/jugular veins 與 carotid arteries 有無 invasion。
  6. 檢查 trachea、esophagus、larynx、cervical muscles。
  7. 評估 mandibular、medial retropharyngeal、superficial cervical nodes。
  8. Thorax 搜尋小型 pulmonary nodules，包括 ground-glass nodule。
  9. Incidental nodule 不因小或規則就放棄 sampling。

P < 0.001。Volume 是強烈 risk-weighting feature，但 ranges overlap，因此沒有安全 cutoff。

Incidental tumors 整體更小、更少侵襲性表型，但仍有 70.6% 為 malignant。

CT Red Flags for Malignancy

Large volume

Malignant median 8.52 cm³。

Inhomogeneity

78.5% malignant tumors precontrast inhomogeneous。

Intratumoral vessels

P < 0.001；研究中只出現在 malignant group。

Invasion

Vascular and tissue invasion 只見於 malignant lesions。

Absence of red flags ≠ benign

小型、規則、卵圓、沒有明顯 invasion 的 thyroid nodule 仍可能是 carcinoma。這篇研究最重要的錯誤避免點，就是不要把 benign-looking incidental nodule 當成 incidental benignity。

Incidentaloma：臨床上怎麼處理

Paper recommendation

中老年犬做 body CT 時應仔細 review neck。Incidental thyroid nodule 應進一步 workup / sampling，避免漏掉 thyroid cancer。

Step 1

確認 contralateral lobe 與 lesion volume。

Step 2

超音波確認 morphology 與 Doppler，並規劃 FNA/biopsy。

Step 3

CT staging：regional nodes、vascular invasion、local tissue invasion、lungs。

Step 4

不要單靠 regular margin 或 absence of metastasis 決定 observation only。

Fig. 2 — Nonincidental thyroid carcinoma with mineralization, intratumoral vessels, and nodal metastasis

中文：一隻 9 歲、未絕育母 Beagle，已知 nonincidental thyroid carcinoma，接受 targeted neck MDCT 進一步評估與 staging。A：腹側視角 3D volume-rendered image，右側甲狀腺葉可見大型卵圓至圓形、邊緣規則的腫塊；白色箭頭標示同側淋巴結轉移。B：造影前橫切面 CT，可見甲狀腺腫塊內礦化。C：造影後影像顯示 angiographic CT series 中有多個小型 intratumoral vessels 顯影。D：橫切面影像顯示右側 medial retropharyngeal lymph node 較對側增大。

English: Targeted MDCT scans of the neck in a 9-year-old, intact female, Beagle dog with known (nonincidental) thyroid carcinoma underwent CT examination for further characterization and staging. (A) Three-dimensional (3D) volume rendered image, ventral view, showing a large ovoid-to-round mass with regular margins of the right thyroid lobe. The white arrow indicates an ipsilateral lymph node metastasis. (B) Precontrast two-dimensional (2D) transverse view. Note the mineralization within the thyroid mass. (C) Postcontrast image of the mass showing multiple small intratumoral vessels enhancing during the angiographic CT series. (D) Two-dimensional transverse view showing an enlarged right medial retropharyngeal lymph node in comparison with the contralateral node.

Fig. 3 — Enhancement patterns in carcinoma and adenoma

中文：三隻犬的 MDCT 顯影 pattern。A：targeted MDCT 顯示 nonincidental bilateral thyroid carcinoma；兩側甲狀腺葉皆呈相似的不均質顯影。B：nontargeted MDCT 發現 bilateral incidental thyroid carcinoma；左葉呈類似 A 的不均質顯影，右葉腫塊則呈周邊顯影並具有大型、均質、不顯影的中心區域。C：nonincidental unilateral thyroid adenoma 的 targeted MDCT；造影後腫塊呈稀少至無顯影，只見薄層周邊顯影。

English: Patterns of enhancement in three different dogs underwent MDCT examination. (A) Targeted MDCT scan of a nonincidental bilateral thyroid carcinoma. Note the inhomogeneous pattern of enhancement, with similar characteristics in both thyroid lobes. (B) Bilateral incidental thyroid carcinoma (nontargeted MDCT scan). The left thyroid lobe showed an inhomogeneous pattern, similar to that shown in (A). The mass of the right thyroid lobe had a peripheral enhancement and a large homogeneous, nonenhancing central area. (C) Targeted MDCT scan of a dog with nonincidental unilateral thyroid adenoma. Note the scarce-null enhancement of the mass after contrast medium injection, showing a thin peripheral enhancement.

Fig. 4 — Thyroid carcinoma with vascular invasion

中文：一隻 nonincidental thyroid carcinoma 犬的 targeted neck MDCT。A：腹側視角 3D volume-rendered image，顯示右側卵圓至圓形甲狀腺腫塊，邊緣不規則，並呈現與周圍血管結構的關係（箭頭）。B：造影前橫切面 CT 顯示腫塊呈不均質 appearance；左側甲狀腺葉外觀正常（LT THY）。C：同一隻犬的造影後橫切面 CT，顯示 tumoral vascular invasion（箭頭）。

English: Targeted MDCT scan of the neck in a dog with nonincidental thyroid carcinoma. (A) Three-dimensional volume rendered image (ventral view) showing the ovoid-to-round, right sided thyroid mass with irregular margins and its relationships with the surrounding vascular structures (arrow). (B) Two-dimensional transverse view of the mass in precontrast scan showing its inhomogenous appearance. The left thyroid lobe had normal appearance (LT THY). (C) Two-dimensional transverse postcontrast image of the same dog, showing the tumoral vascular invasion (arrows).

Fig. 5 — Confirmed local tissue invasion by thyroid carcinoma

中文：兩隻 invasive thyroid carcinoma 犬的橫切面 CT。A：10 歲母 Mongrel，左側 thyroid carcinoma；腫塊呈卵圓至圓形，具有不規則且邊界不清的邊緣，疑似侵犯氣管壁並侵犯周圍頸部肌肉（箭頭）。B：9 歲母 Golden Retriever，右側甲狀腺腫塊在此切面不可見，但腫瘤侵犯食道壁並突出至食道腔內。兩例皆於 necropsy 與 histopathology 證實 tissue invasion。E = esophagus；T = trachea。

English: Transverse CT images from two different dogs with invasive thyroid carcinomas. (A) Two-dimensional transverse view from targeted MDCT scan of the neck in a 10-year-old, female, Mongrel dog, with left sided thyroid carcinoma. The mass was ovoid-to-round with irregular and ill-defined margins showing possible invasion of the tracheal wall and invasion of the surrounding cervical muscles (arrow). (B) Two-dimensional transverse view of the neck in a 9-year-old, female, Golden Retriever with right-sided thyroid mass (not visible here) involving the esophageal wall and projecting into the esophageal lumen. In both cases, necropsy and histopathology confirmed the tissue invasion. E, esophagus; T, trachea.

Fig. 6 — Metastatic incidental thyroid carcinoma

中文：一隻 7 歲公 Boxer 的 metastatic incidental thyroid carcinoma。A：右側旁矢狀面 thin-slab maximum intensity projection（MIP），影像左側為前方；可見卵圓至圓形、邊緣規則的腫塊，造影後呈周邊顯影。B：右側旁矢狀面 2D 影像，顯示腫塊前方的 medial retropharyngeal lymph nodes 增大。C：胸腔橫切面 CT，可見右前肺葉一個小型 ground-glass nodule。淋巴結與肺結節的 postmortem histopathology 均證實轉移性病變。

English: Metastatic incidental thyroid carcinoma in a 7-year-old, male Boxer dog. (A) Right parasagittal thin-slab maximum intensity projection (MIP) of the neck (cranial is on the left), showing an ovoid-to-round mass with regular margins showing peripheral enhancement in postcontrast series (targeted MDCT scan). (B) Right-parasagittal 2D view, showing the enlarged medial retropharyngeal lymph nodes, just cranial to the mass. (C) Two-dimensional transverse view of the thorax. Note a small ground-glass nodule in the apical right lobe. Postmortem histopathology of the lymph nodes and the small lung nodule confirmed the metastatic nature of these lesions.

Clinical Application

Recommended incidental nodule impression

An incidental thyroid nodule is present. Because incidental canine thyroid tumors may be malignant despite small size and regular margins, ultrasound-guided sampling is recommended for definitive characterization.

High-risk mass impression

The thyroid mass is heterogeneous and hypervascular, with irregular margins and suspected vascular/tissue invasion. These findings strongly increase concern for thyroid malignancy. Regional nodal sampling and complete thoracic staging are recommended.

Bottom line

Incidentally found does not mean biologically incidental. 這篇研究中，70.6% incidental thyroid masses 是 carcinoma。
